paite: Huan sinagog ah alut nawn a; huai ah khutzaw khat ana om hi.
heading: Mi Khutzaw Hihdamna / (Mat 12.1-8; Luk 6.1-5)
english: He entered again into the synagogue, and there was a man there whose hand was withered.

paite: Amah ahektheihna ding un Sabbath ni a ahihdam nop leh nop louh a-enkhia uhi.
english: They watched him, whether he would heal him on the Sabbath day, that they might accuse him.

paite: Ama'n khutzaw kiang ah, "Dingkhia in," achi hi.
english: He said to the man whose hand was withered, “Stand up.”

paite: Huan akiang uah, "Sabbath ni in hihhoih hia siang, hihsiat? Hotdam hia siang, hihlup?" chi in adong hi. Himahleh adai dide uhi.
english: He said to them, “Is it lawful on the Sabbath day to do good or to do harm? To save a life or to kill?” But they were silent.

paite: Huan alungtang uh tak ziak a lungkham mahmah leh heh kawm a amaute a-et velvel nung in, huai mi kiang ah, "Na khut zan in," achi a, huchi in azankhia a, akhut adamta hi.
english: When he had looked around at them with anger, being grieved at the hardening of their hearts, he said to the man, “Stretch out your hand.” He stretched it out, and his hand was restored as healthy as the other.

paite: Pharisaite apawtkhia ua, amah hihlup theihna ding lampi ngaihtuah in Herod pawl a mite toh akihoukhawm pah uhi.
english: The Pharisees went out, and immediately conspired with the Herodians against him, how they might destroy him.

paite: Jesu anungzuite toh tuipi lam ah apaimang ua; Galili gam a kipan mipi tampitak in azui uhi.
heading: Hihdamna Dangte
english: Jesus withdrew to the sea with his disciples; and a great multitude followed him from Galilee, from Judea,

paite: Athilhih thupidan azak un Judia gam a kipan, Jerusalem a kipan, Idumai gam a kipan, Jordan gal a kipan, Tura leh Sidon kho kim a kipan in mipi tampitak akiang ah ahong pai uhi.
english: from Jerusalem, from Idumaea, beyond the Jordan, and those from around Tyre and Sidon. A great multitude, hearing what great things he did, came to him.

paite: Mipi ziak in amah a dia long neu mansa a om ding in anungzuite ahilh hi, huchi lou in zaw hon um lutlut kha ding uhi.
english: He spoke to his disciples that a little boat should stay near him because of the crowd, so that they wouldn’t press on him.

paite: Mipi tampi ahihdam tak ziak in natna nei peuhmah in amah akhoihtheihna ding un aboh huthut uhi.
english: For he had healed many, so that as many as had diseases pressed on him that they might touch him.

paite: Dawi ninte'n leng amah amuh un ama ah bokkhup in, "Nang Pathian Tapa na hi," chi in akikou uhi.
english: The unclean spirits, whenever they saw him, fell down before him and cried, “You are the Son of God!”

paite: Huan atanchin genthang lou ding in akiang uah achi bikbek hi.
english: He sternly warned them that they should not make him known.

paite: Huan tang ah ahohtou a, ama'n angaihngaih akiang ah asam a; amau akiang ah ahohtou uhi.
heading: Sawltak Sawm-le-nih Telna / (Mat 10.1-4; Luk 6.12-16)
english: He went up into the mountain and called to himself those whom he wanted, and they went to him.

paite: Akiang a om ding leh thugen dia asawlkhiak ding in sawm-le-nihte asep hi.
english: He appointed twelve, that they might be with him, and that he might send them out to preach

paite: Natnate hihdam ding leh dawite delhkhe ding in thuneihna apia hi.
english: and to have authority to heal sicknesses and to cast out demons:

paite: Huai mite, Simon, Peter, achih pa;
english: Simon (to whom he gave the name Peter);

paite: Zebedai tapa, Jakob leh Jakob unau Johan, huai mite Boanerges achihte; huai omdan tuh vanpiging tapate chihna ahi.
english: James the son of Zebedee; and John, the brother of James, (whom he called Boanerges, which means, Sons of Thunder);

paite: Andru, Philip, Bartholomai, Matthai, Thomas, Alphai tapa Jakob, Thaddai, Kanaan mi Simon leh,
english: Andrew; Philip; Bartholomew; Matthew; Thomas; James, the son of Alphaeus; Thaddaeus; Simon the Zealot;

paite: amansakpa, Judas Iskariot ahi uhi.
english: and Judas Iscariot, who also betrayed him. Then he came into a house.

paite: Huai zoh in, inn khat ah alut uhi. Huai ah mipi tampi ahong kikhawm nawn ua, huchi in an nangawn leng ane thei kei uhi.
heading: Jesu Leh Beelzibul / (Mat 12.22-32; Luk 11.14-23; 12.10)
english: The multitude came together again, so that they could not so much as eat bread.

paite: Huan alawmte'n azak un, "Lungsim buai ahita," chi in amah mat atum uhi.
english: When his friends heard it, they went out to seize him; for they said, “He is insane.”

paite: Huan laigelhmi, Jerusalem a kipan a hong sukte'n, "Beelzibul zawl ahi, dawite kumpipa ziak in ahi, dawite adelhkhiak," achi uhi.
english: The scribes who came down from Jerusalem said, “He has Beelzebul,” and, “By the prince of the demons he casts out the demons.”

paite: Jesu'n laigelhmite asam a, gentehna in akiang uah, "Setan in Setan mah bangchi in adelhkhe thei dia?
english: He summoned them and said to them in parables, “How can Satan cast out Satan?

paite: Gam leng amah akidouleh huai gam adingkhe thei kei ding hi.
english: If a kingdom is divided against itself, that kingdom cannot stand.

paite: Inkuan khat leng amah akidou uleh, huaite inkuan adingkhe thei kei ding uhi.
english: If a house is divided against itself, that house cannot stand.

paite: Setan leng amah kidou a, akilanleh adingkhe thei kei ding a, amangthang zaw ding hi.
english: If Satan has risen up against himself, and is divided, he can’t stand, but has an end.

paite: Kuamah in mihatpa ahen masak phot keileh inn a lut in asum alaksak thei kei uh, huai nung in bel a-inn alok mai ding uhi.
english: But no one can enter into the house of the strong man to plunder unless he first binds the strong man; then he will plunder his house.

paite: "Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, mihing tate, akhelhna tengteng uah leh Pathian agensiatna bangpeuh uah leng agensiatnate uh ngaihdam ahi ding hi.
english: “Most certainly I tell you, all sins of the descendants of man will be forgiven, including their blasphemies with which they may blaspheme;

paite: Kuapeuh Kha Siangthou hilhial gensia zaw chik mah chiang in ngaihdam ahi kei ding a, tangtawn khelhna ah siam louh in a-om zaw ding," achi hi.
english: but whoever may blaspheme against the Holy Spirit never has forgiveness, but is subject to eternal condemnation.”

paite: Dawi nin pai ahi, achih ziak un huai agen ahi.
english: —because they said, “He has an unclean spirit.”

paite: Huan anu leh a-unaute ahong ua, inpua ah adingh ua; amah sam ding in mi asawl uhi.
heading: Jesu Nu Leh Sanggamte / (Mat 12.46-50; Luk 8.19-21)
english: His mother and his brothers came, and standing outside, they sent to him, calling him.

paite: Akim a mipi tu diamduamte'n akiang ah, "Ngai dih, inpua ah na nu leh na sanggampate'n ahon ngak uh," achi uhi.
english: A multitude was sitting around him, and they told him, “Behold, your mother, your brothers, and your sisters are outside looking for you.”

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Ka nu leh ka sanggampate kuate ahi ua?" chi in adong hi.
english: He answered them, “Who are my mother and my brothers?”

paite: Akiang a tute a-en vialvial a, "En un, ka nu leh ka sanggampate;
english: Looking around at those who sat around him, he said, “Behold, my mother and my brothers!

paite: kuapeuh Pathian deihlam hih photphot ka sanggampa, ka sanggamnu leh ka nu ahi uh," achi hi.
english: For whoever does the will of God is my brother, my sister, and mother.”
